## WireIntegerSchema variable

Schema for an integer control record, `{ "integer": "<decimal text>" }`<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
WireIntegerSchema: z.ZodType<WireInteger>
```

## Remarks

The text must match `^(0|-?[1-9][0-9]*)$` (so `"-0"`<!-- -->, `"007"`<!-- -->, and `"+1"` are rejected) and its value must lie within [INTEGER_LIMITS](./contracts.integer_limits.md) (so `"9007199254740992"` is rejected). Validating text never rounds it.
